name: ProofHub
description: ProofHub is an all-in-one project-management and team-collaboration platform. Teams use it to organize projects, tasks, boards, Gantt plans, discussions, files, notes, time, forms, announcements, calendars, proofing, and reports in one workspace.
agentUseSummary: Add your ProofHub account name and API key once, then select which agents can read or manage the work available to that ProofHub user under Safe or Dangerous policy.

credentialRequirements.name: PROOFHUB_ACCOUNT
credentialRequirements.label: ProofHub account name
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the first part of your ProofHub URL. For example, enter acme for https://acme.proofhub.com.

credentialRequirements.name: PROOFHUB_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: ProofHub API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: In ProofHub, open your profile menu > API access and copy or reset the key. API access requires an eligible plan.

capabilities.label: Read projects and collaboration
capabilities.description: Read authorized projects, categories, groups, people, roles, discussions, comments, task lists, tasks, files, events, milestones, notebooks, notes, folders, time, forms, announcements, labels, and related ProofHub data.

capabilities.label: Manage projects and collaboration
capabilities.description: Create, update, move, copy, upload, attach, complete, reopen, and delete resources through ProofHub's documented API, subject to the connected user's authority.

allowed.label: Read ProofHub
allowed.description: Run one bounded GET request against ProofHub's documented API v3.

approvalRequired.label: Manage ProofHub
approvalRequired.description: Run one bounded POST, PUT, or DELETE request, including documented uploads; Safe mode requires approval.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: The API key never enters agent-visible requests, URLs, or results.

blocked.label: Use another origin
blocked.description: Every request is pinned to the validated customer subdomain under proofhub.com.

blocked.label: Run an unbounded transfer
blocked.description: Relay bounds paths, query values, JSON bodies, uploads, redirects, results, nesting, and execution time.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded reads run directly. Every write, upload, invitation, deletion, or administrative operation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected key-authorized ProofHub operation runs without Relay per-action approval. Connection ownership, provider authority, fixed account routing, request bounds, credential protection, provider limits, and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts separate bounded read and manage tools and attaches the encrypted key only at the validated ProofHub account origin.
Relay mounts separate bounded read and manage tools and attaches the encrypted key only at the validated ProofHub account origin.

providerSetup.blocker: A ProofHub customer on an API-enabled plan must supply their account subdomain and user API key. ProofHub documents user-generated API keys rather than a distributable Relay-owned OAuth application.
providerSetup.nextAction: Copy the account name from the ProofHub URL, generate or copy the key under profile > API access, connect both in Relay Console, then run health, read, Safe manage approval, Dangerous manage, upload, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial checks.

evidence.supports: ProofHub's current help center tells users to open profile > API access to copy or reset their own API key and links to the official API v3 repository.

ProofHub documents customer-subdomain HTTPS API v3 URLs, X-API-KEY authentication, mandatory application identification, JSON reads and writes, file uploads, and a rate limit of 25 calls per 10 seconds per account and IP.
ProofHub's current pricing comparison lists API Access on the Ultimate Control plan rather than the Essential plan.
ProofHub describes project and task management, discussions, files, notes, time tracking, collaboration, proofing, reporting, mobile access, integrations, and API access as product capabilities.
